killedBy: hud: every ending gets its own screen (issue #323) keeps the VERSUS result screen OUT of the copy table, and gives it the #279 action set
why: Names a PLAYER for a team victory. `VersusResult` carries `winner-slot` and `winner-team` as separate shapes precisely because the two mean different things, and the numbers collide plausibly -- team 1 and player 1 are both `1` -- so a screen that read the wrong field looks right in a two-player fixture and names a player who may not even have been the last one standing in a four-player teams match.
